lines.text: When the Ziphites told Saul that David was hiding among them, David asked God to save him by His name.
David asks God to hear his prayer because ruthless men with no regard for God seek his life.
David says God is his helper and sustainer, and asks Him to destroy his enemies in His mercy.
David promises to freely sacrifice to the LORD and to praise His name because it is good.
David says God has delivered him from every enemy, and his eyes have looked in triumph on his foes.
